Mop is an established floor-washing implement in DEX2009/DOOM2021 https://dexonline.ro/definitie/mop. Original Vileda Turbo instructions https://www.viledaromania.ro/spin-mops/turbo-spin-mop show the floor/water/bucket tool; the ordinary microfiber replacement https://www.viledaromania.ro/Mops/Cap-de-mop-Turbo-2in1/p/151609 explicitly collects floor dust and hair. The served absorbent-headed owner is correct. No assertion is made that all mops require detergent/buckets or are dry dusters. The proposed exact dust association is factually supported; difficulty/journey fairness is separate.

Aspirator is a suction appliance in longstanding DEX entries https://dexonline.ro/definitie/aspirator, with the everyday floor-appliance sense specified by the served owner. Kärcher original household-vacuum page https://www.karcher.com/ro/ro/home-and-garden/produse/aspiratoare-c4250 explicitly removes deposited household dust from floors and carpets. Nasal/industrial meanings do not change this clearly framed home-use owner. No water requirement is inferred. The five direct recognizable neighbors include co-use associations, so numerical count alone does not establish final C3/C4 quality.
